title: A protected extension point
prompt: Implement `class Greeter` with `std::string greet() const` returning `"Hello, " + salutation()` where `salutation()` is a protected member function returning `"world"`. Implement `class FormalGreeter : public Greeter` overriding nothing but the base stays intact — the test calls both through their own types.

tests.name: base
tests.hint: The base composes greet from a protected hook.

tests.hint: The derived inherits the whole shape.
